Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. team,

You stress proving your reliability, yet your proposed quality commitment allows more defects than your recorded performance—it seems earning our confidence is central to your offer. We want a lasting partnership built on measurable defect reduction and prevention rather than financial penalties. How will you substantiate a tighter, binding quality commitment with a documented corrective-action report?

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months. Your quality over the last 12 months was 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3). Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10). Our demand forecast for Bearing bracket HN is up +20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09). Please send us your 8D report and a binding ppm commitment. Straight talk: over the last 12 months we paid 96% of your invoices late, on average 10 days after the due date. That is on us, and it ends with this contract: every invoice paid on the due date, which brings your cash in about 10 days earlier than you are used to.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (300 ppm, EUR 0 per complaint, EUR 42.77 per unit). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hello,
thank you for your mail, we are very happy to hear from you!
we can move a bit:
Our terms: a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.
To be fully transparent with you:
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything.
Thanks for being straight about the late payments; getting paid on time is a big deal for us and we really appreciate it.
We can't promise 300 ppm right now, but we can commit to 2500 ppm, which is right in line with our recent numbers.
With the better payment terms and the volume increase, we can drop the price to 45.50 EUR per unit.
Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 2500 ppm: €45.50 per unit.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net.
Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.
We are ready when you are!
Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

You have confirmed the quality commitment while stressing that you cannot give up margin—it sounds like accountability must be workable without adding financial strain. How can we make the quality commitment commercially sustainable while ensuring those actions prevent repeat complaints?

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months. We raised quality notifications on this part over the past year (qn:20005025, qn:20004952, qn:20004756, qn:20004747). What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (300 ppm, EUR 0 per complaint, EUR 44.01 per unit). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o. team,

You acknowledge the cost evidence but return to protecting margin; it sounds like financial stability is your overriding concern. We want sustained quality improvement with clear accountability, without adding avoidable financial strain. How will the corrective actions in your attached report ensure that your quality commitment is consistently met?

We confirm a binding volume of 15,900 units per year for 12 months. Our recent orders for Bearing bracket HN were at 45.15 per 1 (po:4500014306-10, po:4500014373-10, po:4500014429-10). We accept your price. On the chargeback: at the 300 ppm you commit to, EUR 300 per complaint means about 5 complaints a year, around EUR 1,431 - it only costs you if quality slips below your own commitment. Alternatively the second sheet, without a chargeback.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (300 ppm, EUR 300 per complaint, EUR 45.00 per unit; 300 ppm, EUR 0 per complaint, EUR 44.95 per unit). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
